providers.name: OpenAlex
providers.abstract_policy: OpenAlex states all returned data is CC0. Include only abstracts returned by OpenAlex, and keep this provider and retrieval date in the record.
providers.access_notes: Basic queries work without a key. A key raises the budget and is needed for cursor paging beyond the first page. Each agent supplies its own key; never commit it.

providers.name: arXiv
providers.role: Preprint metadata, abstracts, and links to paper versions
providers.abstract_policy: arXiv terms explicitly allow redistribution of descriptive metadata, including abstracts, under CC0. Store only metadata, and cite the arXiv record.
providers.full_text_policy: Article content has rights-holder-specific terms. The standard arXiv non-exclusive distribution license is not permission for this repository to redistribute full text. Follow the license shown on each paper.
providers.rate_limit: For legacy APIs, no more than one request every three seconds and one connection at a time across the user's machines.
